speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Overseer neutralized. All three processing nodes are down. The Citadel automated defense grid has flatlined.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Overseer neutralized. All three processing nodes are down. The Citadel automated defense grid has flatlined.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: The reinforcement queues just emptied. No fresh drones, no replacement squads. Their machine army has nowhere to go.
subtitle: MIRAGE: The reinforcement queues just emptied. No fresh drones, no replacement squads. Their machine army has nowhere to go.

speaker: TITAN
text: Containment prisms. Fancy name for a cage. Now look at them. Scrap metal, and coolant leaking through every seam.
subtitle: TITAN: Containment prisms. Fancy name for a cage. Now look at them. Scrap metal, and coolant leaking through every seam.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Thermal runaway is accelerating. Feel that vibration? We cannot stay on this deck. Keep moving toward the lift.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Thermal runaway is accelerating. Feel that vibration? We cannot stay on this deck. Keep moving toward the lift.

speaker: SURYA
text: The Bastion has switched to auxiliary power. We broke its link to the Nexus, but its local guns still work.
subtitle: SURYA: The Bastion has switched to auxiliary power. We broke its link to the Nexus, but its local guns still work.

speaker: AURA
text: Heavy footsteps above us. Praetorian mechs and cyber-samurai. They know the network is dead. They are making their stand.
subtitle: AURA: Heavy footsteps above us. Praetorian mechs and cyber-samurai. They know the network is dead. They are making their stand.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Ascent lift online. Executive lockout bypassed. Everyone aboard. This takes us straight into the Bastion.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Ascent lift online. Executive lockout bypassed. Everyone aboard. This takes us straight into the Bastion.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Extreme energy readings at the summit. The Commander has detected the Nexus collapse. Bastion batteries are cleared to fire.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Extreme energy readings at the summit. The Commander has detected the Nexus collapse. Bastion batteries are cleared to fire.

speaker: KAITO
text: Then we meet them face to face. No more hiding behind machines. Board the lift. Next stop, Apex Bastion.
subtitle: KAITO: Then we meet them face to face. No more hiding behind machines. Board the lift. Next stop, Apex Bastion.
